symbols.label: Clear water
symbols.advice: Clear water is a cleansed heart. Start today with an empty mind.

symbols.label: Fire & sparks
symbols.meaning: Energy igniting, a new beginning stirring
symbols.advice: The ember is growing now. Light fire to the task you postponed.

symbols.label: Flying high
symbols.meaning: Breaking free toward freedom and achievement
symbols.advice: The higher you float, the wider the view. Draw the big picture today.

symbols.label: A pig
symbols.meaning: A classic fortune dream — wealth rolling in
symbols.advice: Fortune lands in prepared hands. Keep your wallet tidy today.

symbols.label: A snake
symbols.meaning: Wealth and change arriving together — a powerful turn
symbols.advice: You must shed the old skin to grow. Retire one worn-out habit today.

symbols.label: Teeth falling
symbols.meaning: Courage wavering, but recovery soon follows
symbols.advice: Teeth grow back. Add one small victory to your shaken courage today.

symbols.label: Falling
symbols.meaning: Unstable ground — a warning to recheck your base
symbols.advice: Falling is a preview of landing. Slow down and check your foundation.

symbols.label: Being chased
symbols.meaning: Your inner self says there is something you avoid
symbols.advice: Face the shadow head-on and it vanishes.

symbols.label: Stars
symbols.meaning: Wishes being woven, threads of opportunity arriving
symbols.advice: Stars are distant lighthouses. Make one wish concrete today.

symbols.label: A door
symbols.advice: Doors open only for those who knock. Knock first today.

symbols.label: Flowers blooming
symbols.meaning: Bonds and luck blossoming — a good omen
symbols.advice: Flowers bloom on timing. Deliver one kind greeting today.

symbols.label: The sun
symbols.meaning: Honor and bright news arriving with daylight
symbols.advice: Sunlight shows direction. Affairs moving east favor you today.

symbols.label: The moon
symbols.meaning: Intuition and calm filling up like the tide
symbols.advice: The moon is waxing. Trust the rhythm instead of rushing.

symbols.label: A dream within a dream
symbols.meaning: A hidden wish trying to surface from the deep
symbols.advice: When a dream calls another dream, the wish is real. Write it down today.
